title: an unrecognized declared-buffer `kind` is rejected up front, instead of silently falling out of later dispatch logic
error_substring: has unknown kind 'texture_future' (supported: lookup); upgrade eagle
why: All four loaders use buffer `kind` to decide which buffers to consolidate,
not to validate them — so an unrecognized kind used to fall silently out of
the binding set instead of failing. This fixture pins that the shared
validator now rejects an unrecognized kind up front, so the later dispatch
logic (which is unchanged, and still only used for dispatch) can never be
The rejection message is written to be identical, substring for substring,
